notes: Source: Butler County BOE 'Candidate & Petition Activity' report dated 10/6/2026 (all county candidates marked certified (C) 08-20-2026; issues certified 08-17-2026, Issue 17 certified 09-09-2026) cross-checked against the board's FWAB 46-day election notice dated 10/2/2026. No municipal, township or school-board candidate races appear on the Nov 3, 2026 ballot (Ohio elects those in odd years); only county offices and county judgeships are listed. The 'Withdrawn 9/16/2026' note on page 3 of the petition report refers to a 12th District Court of Appeals write-in candidate, not to the County Auditor race (both Auditor candidates appear on the FWAB notice). Common Pleas judges appear on the ballot without party (board lists them as (N)); the board's petition report does not say 'General Division' but its FWAB notice does, so 'General Division' is included in the office name. Butler publishes no ballot text for issues beyond the title/mills/term lines in the petition report and FWAB notice, so ballotLanguage is a one-sentence description built from those. Issues 4, 5 and 9 are filed with Hamilton County (Northwest and Southwest Local SDs) and Preble County (Village of College Corner) but appear on Butler ballots in the overlapping precincts under Butler's numbering. Issue 3 (state constitutional amendment) is omitted per RULES. Local liquor options: Issue 15 precinct MIDD2WD3 is in the City of Middletown; Issue 16 precinct WC39 is in West Chester Township. No write-in-only county races (write-in filings are only for Governor, U.S. Senate and 12th District Court of Appeals).
